title: Metal oxide-polymer hybrid composites: a comprehensive review on synthesis and multifunctional applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,18173-18208

Mariam Akhtar, Sehar Shahzadi, Muhammad Arshad, Tahreem Akhtar, Muhammad Ramzan Saeed Ashraf Janjua
Metal oxide-conducting polymer hybrids show great promise as efficient catalysts for water splitting, advancing sustainable energy. This review covers recent progress, challenges, and future prospects of these multifunctional materials.
